description: T2.M1 items 4 and 8: closed-door scene, the door swung shut over 1 s at the calibrated batch (880 probes a frame); the dark room leak (dark-room-leak-view / lit-room GI means) must be <= 1% from 1 s after it closed, through 10 s.
